sourceIssues.locator: He21, published Forum of Mathematics, Pi 9 (2021), e9, §6.3, paragraph invoking [He15, Theorem 2.27]; construction in §5.4.
sourceIssues.correction: Supply basic nonemptiness for the constructed a t^γ without assuming that this new alcove is shrunken. A general criterion still requires its own hypotheses to be proved; replacing the citation alone is not a proof.
sourceIssues.reason: The cited survey theorem assumes a shrunken alcove. In split adjoint A2 take λ=ω2∨, x=s2s1, y=1. The published construction gives J=∅, J′={s1}, x′=s2, z=s1, γ=λ, y′=1 and a=s1s2. On the negative base alcove u<0, v<0, u+v>−1, w sends (u,v) to (v−1,1−u−v), with positive-root ranges (−2,−1),(1,2),(0,1). The seed a t^γ sends it to (1−u−v,u), whose second coordinate lies in the critical strip (−1,0). Both finite factors have full support. This disproves applicability of the cited theorem, not nonemptiness or the main result. The extraction’s stronger claim that every nonregular γ causes failure is false and is not retained.

sourceIssues.locator: He21, published version, §6.2, application of GHN15 Lemma 3.6.3, with the definition in §6.1.
sourceIssues.correction: Use (J,x,σ), with x the left factor in w=x t^λ y. Apply the obstruction to x^{-1}wσ(x)=t^λσ(ησ(w)).
sourceIssues.reason: GHN15 uses the chamber factor x. The corrected finite factor is in W_J because J is σ-stable and contains the support of ησ(w). The printed conjugator can fail even the defining parabolic-membership condition: in split A2 take x=s2, y=s1s2 and λ=3ρ∨. Then η=yx=s1 and J={s1}, whereas y^{-1}xy²=s2 is outside W_J. The different element printed inside the Kottwitz map, σ^{-1}(y)wy^{-1}=ησ(w)t^λ, nevertheless has the same Levi Kottwitz image as the corrected one. Thus the numerical obstruction survives. The existential wording of §6.5 is not counted as a separate counterexample.

sourceIssues.locator: He21, published version, Proposition 5.1 proof, existence of the asserted unique minimal feasible coweight.
sourceIssues.correction: Add nonemptiness and existence of a minimal element before using the proved common-lower-bound property. Use μ0=λ−λ′+N·2ρ∨, where 2ρ∨ is the sum of all positive coroots, for sufficiently large integral N.
sourceIssues.reason: Each simple-root pairing with 2ρ∨ is 2, so μ0 is dominant for large N and μ0+λ′−λ is in the nonnegative integral coroot cone. If μ≤_Zμ0 is dominant and μ0−μ=Σ n_iα_i∨, then Σ n_i=〈ρ,μ0−μ〉≤〈ρ,μ0〉; hence there are finitely many such μ. A minimal feasible element below μ0 exists, and lower-directedness makes it globally least. This is a routine completion, not a false theorem. The inherited proposed direction Σ(simple coroots) is wrong: in D4 its simple-root pairings are (1,−1,1,1). Input item /53 already uses the valid 2ρ∨ direction.

sourceIssues.locator: He21, published version, §2.2 standing reduction and §§5.2–5.4 auxiliary coweights and translations.
sourceIssues.correction: Specify the adjoint/full-coweight datum in which the auxiliary construction is performed, and justify transfer of the final geometric statement to the original group. Do not demand nonexistent lifts of intermediate translations.
sourceIssues.reason: For split SL3, ω1∨=(2α1∨+α2∨)/3 is not a cocharacter, so the factor t^{ρ_J∨} with J={s1} is not in its Iwahori–Weyl group. The obstruction can persist in γ: in unramified simply connected ²A2, let σ exchange the nodes, λ=(3,3), x=1,y=s1 in fundamental-coweight coordinates. Then x′=s2 and γ=λ−ω1∨+s2ω2∨=(3,2), with coroot coordinates (8/3,7/3), whereas λ has integral coroot coordinates (3,3). Equality of auxiliary Kottwitz coinvariants does not produce a lift. GHN’s adjoint comparison is componentwise after its erratum and carries an equal-characteristic coprimality restriction; ramified and mixed-characteristic applications need their actual comparison. No counterexample to He21 Theorem 6.1 is claimed.

sourceIssues.reason: The authors’ erratum, Proposition 0.0.1, removes automatic injectivity and gives the corrected componentwise statement. The He21 adjoint reduction must import the corrected result, rather than the original global assertion.
